_doc: Harvey LAB workspace RRSI adapter. Evolve/held-out IDs must come from the private verified inventory bundle, never a local regenerated split. Policy inference defaults to loopback; the official Harvey rubric judge is remote and requires separate remote_evaluation_opt_in. Score is criterion-weighted pass fraction. Paper selection values are retained for comparison only; actual baseline, noise, held-out, and cost evidence must be measured before acceptance.
_threadforge_modifications: Consent defaults and the private verified inventory requirement were added by Threadforge; see python/UPSTREAM_MODIFICATIONS.md.
